overview_description.description:
Satispay is a thriving European payment network with the goal to change the way people pay in stores and online, and exchange money between friends.

Launched in 2015, Satispay is independent from debit and credit cards. Easy and cost-convenient for businesses–who can accept payments from clients with a click on their smartphone, tablet, or pc–Satispay is also a simple and secure app for consumers, simplifying the way they pay, as well as a range of other services.

about_short_description.short_description: Satispay is a fintech company that provides a bank account enabled mobile payment platform.

product.name: Satispay App
product.description: A mobile payment and digital wallet app for paying in stores and online, transferring money to contacts, saving toward goals, and handling selected everyday payments and top-ups.

product.name: Satispay Business
product.description: A merchant payment acceptance service that lets shops and businesses accept Satispay payments in physical stores and online, with integrations for checkout, POS, and cash-register workflows.

product.name: Satispay Welfare
product.description: A digital corporate-welfare platform that provides employers with meal vouchers, purchase vouchers, and flexible benefits that employees use through the Satispay app and affiliated merchant network.

product.name: Satispay Investments
product.description: An investment service integrated into the Satispay app that enables users to invest small amounts, including recurring contributions, and withdraw funds subject to the applicable product terms and risks.

product.name: Satispay IBAN
product.description: An IBAN-enabled account service that allows users to receive bank transfers and manage funds associated with their Satispay wallet.

product.name: Satispay Debit Cards
product.description: Mastercard debit cards linked to Satispay that enable users to pay in stores and online, including internationally, through card-based transactions.
